description: Only the camera on the live screen records picture; each cut switches which camera records. Every sound source records for the whole take. The pieces are joined into one program file.
times: seconds from take_started_utc, wall clock; a segment's media_offset and first_frame_at, and a started cut's effective_at, are take time: wall time with the pauses before them taken out

assembly.audio: follows the picture: each camera's own sound
